title: feat(source): add Amp (ampcode.com) trace ingestion
body:
Adds an `amp` source that ingests Amp thread traces.

## Why a new source

Amp does not persist full thread bodies on disk. The CLI only keeps
credentials, a prompt history, and a session pointer under
`~/.local/share/amp` — the canonical thread state lives on Amp Server
(`ampcode.com`) and is downloaded on demand. So unlike Claude Code,
Codex, opencode, etc. there is no native store to crawl. The new source
instead reads exported trace JSON files (one trace per `T-<uuid>.json`
file) from a directory the user controls.

## What's in the source

* Default root: `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/mnemosyne/amp` (mirrors `supplied`).
  Subdirectories of the root become groupings; bare files at the root
  collapse into an `amp:default` bucket. Discovery only stats files —
  it doesn't parse them — so surveys stay cheap on big export dumps.
* Each trace maps to one `schema.Record`:
  * `id` → `RecordID`, `title` → `Title`, `created` / `updatedAt` → start / end
  * `env.initial.trees[0].uri` → `WorkingDir`
  * Per-message `text` blocks concatenate into `Turn.Text`; `thinking`
    blocks become `Turn.Reasoning` (honours `SuppressReasoning`)
  * Assistant `usage` rolls up into `Record.Usage` (input/output tokens
    counted, including cache read/creation)
  * Amp-specific fields (`agentMode`, `visibility`, `workspaceID`,
    `projectID`, `clientVersion`, `clientType`, `creatorUserID`) flow
    through verbatim under `Extensions["amp"]`
* Implements `SessionLookup` so the orchestrator can splice richer Amp
  trace content into its mirror records.

## Wiring

* Registered in `internal/sources/registry.go` (and the registry test).
* Added to the orchestrator's `defaultLookups`, with
  `normalizeAgentType` handling `amp`, `amp-cli`, `ampcode`, and
  `ampcodecli` variants.
* README's supported-source list now includes Amp.

## Tests

`go test ./...` is green. New tests in `internal/source/amp` cover
discovery bucketing, the canonical extract path (against a fixture
derived from a real Amp trace), reasoning suppression, malformed-file
warnings, and `LookupSession`. Orchestrator's `normalizeAgentType` test
is extended with the new variants.
